summary: FRONTEND STOREFRONT E2E PASSED end-to-end on the real GLP backend via /api/glp/* proxy. Playwright mobile viewport (390x844). Flows verified: (1) 'Create an account' → register screen; (2) Validation #1 'invalid tg + short password' shows 'At least 8 characters' + telegram error inline on the fields; (3) Validation #2 'blank telegram' blocks submit and keeps user on register screen; (4) Valid registration (email=e2eapp+<ts>@mailinator.com, tg=e2etg_<ts>, pw>=8) auto-approves and lands on home tabs; (5) Home 'Available now' rail renders REAL products (C-10 £52.99, R-60 £138, T-100 £139.99, R-40 £116.99, Tesamorelin £69.99, R-40/C@gri £166.99, T-60 £112, T-30 £63.99, OFG £74.99, R-20mg £92.99, test £0.10) — NOT demo data; (6) Product 177 opens with product-screen and shows 3 variation options (variation-option-type-Device, -Refill, -vial); selecting one enables add-to-basket-button; (7) Add-to-basket pushed line into basket; (8) Basket screen shows Subtotal, has NO coupon field, has proceed-checkout-button; (9) /checkout screen renders fields; filling First='Jamie', Line1='10 Downing St', City='London', Postcode='EC1A 1BB', Phone fires shipping quote and returns [co-ship-flat_rate:1 'Flat rate £6.00']; (10) place-order-button creates REAL order and navigates to /checkout/invoice/{id} (saw order id=259); (11) Invoice screen auto-progresses to COMPLETE (status='complete') and shows 'Payment received' with 'View my orders' (testID=invoice-view-orders) — this is the 'paid' branch of the invoice component; (12) Orders tab renders 'No orders yet' empty state for a brand-new account correctly. NOTE: Because the live backend NOW has Crypto Test Mode flipped ON, the invoice jumps straight to status='complete' at the first poll, so the pre-payment UI (invoice-amount, invoice-copy-address, QR, countdown, CRYPTO TEST MODE pill, invoice-recheck) was not visually displayed in this run — the component code (checkout/invoice/[id].tsx) contains these correctly behind the `paid === false` branch and the backend-driven status transition skipped them. Overall storefront flow is HEALTHY — no blocking bugs. React Native issues to report: nested Pressable renders as nested <button> which triggers a React 'cannot be descendant' hydration warning in the web preview.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web nests a Pressable (favourite-button-{id}) inside another Pressable (rail-card-{id}). On web this renders as a <button> inside a <button>, triggering repeated React console errors: 'In HTML, <button> cannot be a descendant of <button>. This will cause a hydration error.' Not a functional break on mobile but polluting logs and could hydrate incorrectly in SSR/web builds. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/product/ProductCard.tsx (and FavouriteButton) via ProductRail.

action_items: Optional UX: wrap FavouriteButton as a non-button Pressable (e.g. use View + onPress with accessibilityRole other than 'button', or hoist the heart icon so it isn't visually inside the card button). Fixes nested-button hydration warning in web preview.

No action needed on invoice flow — the pre-payment UI (amount, address, QR, countdown, CRYPTO TEST MODE pill, recheck button) was not visible in this run only because the backend's crypto test mode auto-progressed the order to status='complete' instantly, so the paid branch rendered immediately with 'Payment received' + 'View my orders'. Component code for the awaiting state is correct in /app/frontend/app/checkout/invoice/[id].tsx; if you want to verify it visually, mock a slower status transition from the backend or temporarily disable test-mode auto-complete to catch awaiting_payment → payment_detected → confirming → complete transitions.
Housekeeping: real test order id=259 was created on ap3p-fitness.com during this run (apeps_crypto/tron, status=complete). Decide whether to cancel/delete via WP admin.
critical_code_review_comments: register.tsx: validation covers all 4 requested cases (empty first_name, invalid email, invalid tg via normalizeTelegram, pw<8). Inline errors render via TextField's `error` prop as expected.
basket.tsx: no coupon field anywhere in the component (confirmed by text search of rendered body — no 'coupon'/'promo code' tokens). Matches review requirement.

checkout.tsx: auto-quote fires 500ms after addressReady becomes true (useEffect debounces by postcode/city/line1). Shipping method flat_rate:1 ('Flat rate £6.00') returned by /api/glp/shipping/quote and selected automatically.

checkout/invoice/[id].tsx: all requested testIDs are present in code (invoice-screen, invoice-amount, invoice-copy-address, invoice-recheck, invoice-view-orders, invoice-status) and CRYPTO TEST MODE pill is rendered when invoice.testMode is true. Observed status transitioned directly to 'complete' on the live backend's first poll.

seed_data_creation: Authorized real data created on live GLP backend during this run: at least one fresh customer account e2eapp+<ts>@mailinator.com (telegram=e2etg_<ts>, auto-approved) and real order id=259 (apeps_crypto/tron, status=complete). Multiple validation-only registrations were submitted but blocked client-side so did NOT create records.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live GLP backend currently has Crypto Test Mode ON — invoices auto-progress to status='complete' on first poll, so the InvoiceScreen immediately renders the 'Payment received' branch. If you need to visually verify invoice-amount / invoice-copy-address / invoice-recheck / CRYPTO TEST MODE pill, you'll need to intercept the GET /api/glp/orders/{id}/crypto-invoice response to return status='awaiting_payment' once before letting it progress. Known-good product for variable-flow testing: product_id=177 with 3 variations under attribute 'type' (Device/Refill/vial). UK postcode 'EC1A 1BB' returns flat_rate:1 at £6.00. TextField component renders testID directly on the <input> element (NOT on a wrapper) — use selector `input[data-testid="..."]` in Playwright.
rca_of_issue: No bug raised in this iteration. One minor React Native Web warning (nested <button> hydration error from FavouriteButton inside rail-card Pressable) — not a functional break on mobile but is logged every render on web. Fix: give FavouriteButton accessibilityRole other than 'button' OR position it as a sibling of the card instead of a child.
